```{r Set Interpolation Variables}

# Columns to interpolate
Columns_to_interpolate <- c("Vulnerability", "BII", "BDH", "BHI", "RNC/TC Ratio", "WBNCR", "WBTC","BHISpecies", "BHIAvg", 
 "PB", "DebtGDP", "FM_Depth", "WGI_CC", "WGI_GE", "WGI_RL", "WGI_RQ",
 "ITwoYrSpread", "IFiveYrSpread", "ITenYrSpread") # Spreads interpolated only for PCA robustness check

# Create numeric time variable ("TimeNumeric") for interpolation and duplicate spread columns
QData <- QData %>%
  mutate(
    ITwoYrSpread = TwoYrSpread, # Robustness check for PCA factors, we interpolate missing values of the spread series
    IFiveYrSpread = FiveYrSpread, # The interpolated values are not used throughout the analysis otherwise
    ITenYrSpread = TenYrSpread,
    Year = as.numeric(Year),
    Q = as.numeric(Q),
    TimeNumeric = Year + (Q - 1) / 4
  )

# Convert YearQtr to yearquarter class (zoo) for plotting
QData$YearQtr <- as.yearqtr(QData$YearQtr)
```

```{r Compute EPI: Biodiversity and Habitat Sub-index}
Nature_Data <- read_excel("QData.xlsx", sheet = "Nature")

# EPI Biodiversity & Habitat Sub-index (BDH): weighted average of 8 sub-indicators.
# Raw weights from the most recent Environmental Performance Index (EPI) methodology note from 2024, normalised to sum to 1:
#   MKP  Marine KBA Protection          0.12  -> 0.146
#   MHP  Marine Habitat Protection       0.12  -> 0.146
#   MPE  Marine Protection Stringency    0.02  -> 0.024
#   SPI  Species Protection Index        0.16  -> 0.195
#   TBN  Terrestrial Biome Protection    0.10  -> 0.122
#   TKP  Terrestrial KBA Protection      0.10  -> 0.122
#   RLI  Red List Index                  0.12  -> 0.146
#   SHI  Species Habitat Index           0.08  -> 0.098

bdh_raw_weights <- c(MKP = 0.12, MHP = 0.12, MPE = 0.02, SPI = 0.16,
                     TBN = 0.10, TKP = 0.10, RLI = 0.12, SHI = 0.08)
bdh_norm_weights <- bdh_raw_weights / sum(bdh_raw_weights)

Nature_Data <- Nature_Data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    BDH_computed = {
      vals <- c_across(all_of(names(bdh_raw_weights)))
      avail <- !is.na(vals)
      if (sum(avail) == 0) NA_real_
      else sum(vals[avail] * bdh_norm_weights[avail]) / sum(bdh_norm_weights[avail])
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Validation against existing Excel BDH (where all 8 present, exact match expected)
validation_bdh <- Nature_Data %>%
  filter(!is.na(BDH) & !is.na(BDH_computed)) %>%
  mutate(diff = abs(BDH - BDH_computed))
cat("BDH validation: max diff =", max(validation_bdh$diff),
    "| n =", nrow(validation_bdh), "\n")

Nature_Data <- Nature_Data %>%
  mutate(BDH = coalesce(BDH, BDH_computed)) %>%
  select(-BDH_computed)

cat("BDH coverage:", sum(!is.na(Nature_Data$BDH)), "of", nrow(Nature_Data), "rows\n")
```

## Interpolation

```{r Interpolation}
# Function to interpolate missing values for a country's time series
interpolate_country_data <- function(country_data, method = "spline") {
  if (nrow(country_data) <= 1) return(country_data)  # Cannot interpolate with just one point
  # De-duplicate the data to handle cases where multiple entries exist for the same time point
  country_data <- country_data %>%
    distinct(TimeNumeric, .keep_all = TRUE)
  # Get time range for a given country
  time_range <- range(country_data$TimeNumeric, na.rm = TRUE)
  # Create sequence of quarters as numeric values
  all_times <- seq(from = time_range[1], to = time_range[2], by = 0.25)
  # Create complete time sequence dataframe
  complete_seq <- data.frame(
    ISO3 = unique(country_data$ISO3),
    TimeNumeric = all_times
  )
  # Calculate Year and Quarter from TimeNumeric
  complete_seq <- complete_seq %>%
    mutate(
      Year = floor(TimeNumeric),
      Q = (round((TimeNumeric - Year) * 4) + 1),
      YearQtr = as.yearqtr(paste0(Year, " Q", Q))
    )
  # Merge with existing data
  merged_data <- left_join(complete_seq, country_data, by = c("ISO3", "TimeNumeric"))
  # If there's no direct match on TimeNumeric, join by ISO3, Year, and Q
  if (all(is.na(merged_data$`Country Name`))) {
    merged_data <- left_join(
      complete_seq, 
      country_data, 
      by = c("ISO3", "Year", "Q")
    )
  }
  
  # For each variable to interpolate, track the min and max times where real data exists to avoid extrapolation.
  var_bounds <- list()
  
  # List of numeric variables to interpolate (excluding identifier columns)
  numeric_vars <- names(country_data)[sapply(country_data, is.numeric)]
  numeric_vars <- setdiff(numeric_vars, c("Year", "Q", "TimeNumeric"))
  
  # First determine valid bounds for each variable to prevent extrapolation
  for (var in numeric_vars) {
    # Skip if there are fewer than 2 non-NA values
    if (sum(!is.na(merged_data[[var]])) < 2) next
    
    # Find the min and max TimeNumeric where actual data exists
    valid_times <- merged_data$TimeNumeric[!is.na(merged_data[[var]])]
    var_bounds[[var]] <- range(valid_times)
  }
  
  # Apply interpolation to each numeric variable
  for (var in numeric_vars) {
    # Skip if there are fewer than 2 non-NA values
    if (sum(!is.na(merged_data[[var]])) < 2) next
    
    # Get the time bounds for this variable
    bounds <- var_bounds[[var]]
    
    # Only interpolate within the bounds of actual data points
    mask <- merged_data$TimeNumeric >= bounds[1] & merged_data$TimeNumeric <= bounds[2]
    x <- merged_data$TimeNumeric[mask]
    y <- merged_data[[var]][mask]
    
    if (method == "linear") {
      # Linear interpolation
      interp_values <- approx(x[!is.na(y)], y[!is.na(y)], xout = x, method = "linear")$y # calls native piecewise linear interpolation function of R
    } else if (method == "spline") {
      # Cubic spline interpolation
      if (sum(!is.na(y)) >= 4) {  # Need at least 4 points for cubic spline
        interp_values <- spline(x[!is.na(y)], y[!is.na(y)], xout = x)$y # calls native cubic spline interpolation function of R
      } else {
        # Fall back to linear if not enough points
        interp_values <- approx(x[!is.na(y)], y[!is.na(y)], xout = x, method = "linear")$y
      }
    }
    
    # Only update values within the bounds
    merged_data[[var]][mask] <- interp_values
  }
  
  # Fill in missing identifier columns
  id_cols <- c("Country Name", "Crncy Name", "CountryYear", "CountryYrQtr")
  for (col in id_cols) {
    if (col %in% names(merged_data)) {
      # Take the first non-NA value for each ID column
      first_value <- na.omit(unique(country_data[[col]]))[1]
      merged_data[[col]][is.na(merged_data[[col]])] <- first_value
    }
  }
  
  # Compute Countryear and CountryYrQtr if they don't exist
  if ("CountryYear" %in% names(merged_data)) {
    merged_data$CountryYear <- paste0(merged_data$ISO3, merged_data$Year)
  }
  
  if ("CountryYrQtr" %in% names(merged_data)) {
    merged_data$CountryYrQtr <- paste0(merged_data$ISO3, merged_data$Year, "Q", merged_data$Q)
  }
  
  return(merged_data)
}

# Applies interpolation to all countries and merges results back into a copy of qdata
run_interpolation <- function(qdata, method = "spline") {
  countries <- unique(qdata$ISO3)

  interp_list <- lapply(setNames(countries, countries), function(iso) {
    dat <- qdata %>% filter(ISO3 == iso)
    if (nrow(dat) == 0) return(NULL)
    interpolate_country_data(dat, method = method)
  })
  interp_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), interp_list)

  processed <- lapply(interp_list, function(df) {
    if ("YearQtr" %in% names(df)) df$YearQtr <- as.character(df$YearQtr)
    df <- df[, !grepl("\\.x$|\\.y$", names(df))]
    keep <- unique(c("ISO3", "Country Name", "Year", "Q", "TimeNumeric",
                     intersect(names(df), Columns_to_interpolate)))
    df[, intersect(keep, names(df))]
  })

  all_interp <- do.call(rbind, processed)
  rownames(all_interp) <- NULL
  if (!("Year" %in% names(all_interp)) || !("Q" %in% names(all_interp))) {
    all_interp <- all_interp %>%
      mutate(Year = floor(TimeNumeric), Q = round((TimeNumeric - Year) * 4) + 1)
  }
  all_interp <- all_interp %>%
    mutate(YearQtr = as.yearqtr(paste0(Year, " Q", Q)))

  out <- qdata
  for (col in Columns_to_interpolate) {
    if (!(col %in% names(all_interp))) next
    for (iso in countries) {
      ci <- all_interp %>% filter(ISO3 == iso) %>% select(TimeNumeric, !!sym(col))
      if (nrow(ci) == 0 || all(is.na(ci[[col]]))) next
      idx <- which(out$ISO3 == iso & is.na(out[[col]])) # Only targets rows where the value is already NA
      for (i in idx) { # for each missing value, find the corresponding value in the interpolated data frame
        j <- match(out$TimeNumeric[i], ci$TimeNumeric)
        if (!is.na(j) && !is.na(ci[[col]][j])) out[[col]][i] <- ci[[col]][j]
      }
    }
  }

  # Append newly-created quarters present in interpolated output but absent from original, to retain original observations and only add interpolated values. 
  all_keys  <- all_interp %>% select(ISO3, TimeNumeric) %>% distinct()
  orig_keys <- qdata      %>% select(ISO3, TimeNumeric) %>% distinct()
  missing_q <- anti_join(all_keys, orig_keys, by = c("ISO3", "TimeNumeric"))
  if (nrow(missing_q) > 0) {
    new_rows <- all_interp %>% inner_join(missing_q, by = c("ISO3", "TimeNumeric"))
    for (col_add in setdiff(names(out), names(new_rows))) new_rows[[col_add]] <- NA
    new_rows <- new_rows[, names(out), drop = FALSE]
    out <- bind_rows(out, new_rows) %>% arrange(ISO3, TimeNumeric)
  }

  out
}
```

```{r Apply Interpolation}
QData_I        <- run_interpolation(QData, method = "spline")
QData_I_linear <- run_interpolation(QData, method = "linear")

# Report fill rates
original_non_na <- sum(!is.na(QData[Columns_to_interpolate]))
spline_non_na   <- sum(!is.na(QData_I[Columns_to_interpolate]))
cat("Data points added by spline interpolation:",
    round((spline_non_na - original_non_na) / spline_non_na * 100, 2), "%\n")

filled_total <- 0
for (col in Columns_to_interpolate) {
  if (!(col %in% names(QData)) || !(col %in% names(QData_I))) next
  filled <- sum(is.na(QData[[col]])) - sum(is.na(QData_I[[col]]))
  if (filled > 0) {
    cat("Filled", filled, "values in", col, "\n")
    filled_total <- filled_total + filled
  }
}
cat("Total values filled:", filled_total, "\n")
```

```{r Linear-Cubic 50%}
# Q1: use original value; Q2-Q4: average of cubic-spline and linear estimates
QData_I_CL <- QData_I

for (col_name in Columns_to_interpolate) {
  if (!(col_name %in% names(QData_I_CL)) ||
      !(col_name %in% names(QData_I_linear)) ||
      !(col_name %in% names(QData))) next

  original_data_subset <- QData %>%
    select(ISO3, TimeNumeric, original_val = !!sym(col_name)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(original_val)) %>%
    distinct(ISO3, TimeNumeric, .keep_all = TRUE)

  linear_data_subset <- QData_I_linear %>%
    select(ISO3, TimeNumeric, linear_val = !!sym(col_name)) %>%
    distinct(ISO3, TimeNumeric, .keep_all = TRUE)

  QData_I_CL <- QData_I_CL %>%
    left_join(original_data_subset, by = c("ISO3", "TimeNumeric")) %>%
    left_join(linear_data_subset,   by = c("ISO3", "TimeNumeric")) %>%
    mutate(
      !!col_name := case_when(
        Q == 1 & !is.na(original_val)                                        ~ original_val,
        Q == 1 &  is.na(original_val)                                        ~ .data[[col_name]],
        Q %in% 2:4 & !is.na(.data[[col_name]]) & !is.na(linear_val)         ~ linear_val + ((.data[[col_name]] - linear_val) / 2),
        Q %in% 2:4 & !is.na(.data[[col_name]]) &  is.na(linear_val)         ~ .data[[col_name]],
        Q %in% 2:4 &  is.na(.data[[col_name]]) & !is.na(linear_val)         ~ linear_val,
        TRUE                                                                  ~ .data[[col_name]]
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-any_of(c("original_val", "linear_val")))
}
``` 

```{r Comparing Interpolation Methods}
# Diagnostic: plots cubic-spline, linear, and cubic-linear series against original data point
plot_enhanced <- function(country_code, variable_name) {
  original_df <- QData %>%
    filter(ISO3 == country_code, !is.na(!!sym(variable_name))) %>%
    select(TimeNumeric, value = !!sym(variable_name))

  if (!exists("QData_I") || !(variable_name %in% names(QData_I)))
    stop("QData_I not found or missing variable: ", variable_name)
  cubic_line_df <- QData_I %>%
    filter(ISO3 == country_code) %>%
    select(TimeNumeric, value_cubic = !!sym(variable_name)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value_cubic))

  if (!exists("QData_I_linear") || !(variable_name %in% names(QData_I_linear)))
    stop("QData_I_linear not found or missing variable: ", variable_name)
  linear_line_df <- QData_I_linear %>%
    filter(ISO3 == country_code) %>%
    select(TimeNumeric, value_linear = !!sym(variable_name)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value_linear))

  if (!exists("QData_I_CL") || !(variable_name %in% names(QData_I_CL)))
    stop("QData_I_CL not found or missing variable: ", variable_name)
  cubic_linear_line_df <- QData_I_CL %>%
    filter(ISO3 == country_code) %>%
    select(TimeNumeric, value_cubic_linear = !!sym(variable_name)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value_cubic_linear))

  all_times <- unlist(list(original_df$TimeNumeric, cubic_line_df$TimeNumeric, linear_line_df$TimeNumeric))
  if (length(all_times) == 0 || all(is.na(all_times))) {
    min_time <- 1990; max_time <- 2020
  } else {
    min_time <- floor(min(all_times, na.rm = TRUE))
    max_time <- ceiling(max(all_times, na.rm = TRUE))
  }

  ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = cubic_line_df,        aes(x = TimeNumeric, y = value_cubic,        color = "Cubic Spline"),   linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_line(data = linear_line_df,        aes(x = TimeNumeric, y = value_linear,        color = "Linear"),         linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_line(data = cubic_linear_line_df,  aes(x = TimeNumeric, y = value_cubic_linear,  color = "Cubic-Linear"),   linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_point(data = original_df, aes(x = TimeNumeric, y = value), color = "black", size = 2.5, shape = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Cubic Spline" = "blue", "Linear" = "green", "Cubic-Linear" = "red")) +
    labs(title    = paste(variable_name, "for", country_code, "- Interpolation Comparison"),
         subtitle = "Black circles: original data points",
         x = "Year", y = variable_name, color = "Interpolation Method") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min_time, max_time, by = ifelse(max_time - min_time > 20, 2, 1)),
                       limits = c(min_time, max_time))
}

example_country <- unique(QData$ISO3)[8] # select country here
```

## Mutate Variables

```{r Rename and Mutate Variables}
QData_I_CL <- QData_I_CL %>%
  mutate(
    Inv_BII = 100 - BII,
    Inv_BDH = 100 - BDH,
    ln_WBRNC = log(WBNCR),
    Inv_BHI = 100 - BHI,
    Inv_BHISpecies = 100 - BHISpecies,
    Inv_BHIAvg = 100 - BHIAvg,
    `BII_Vul_TC` = Inv_BII * `RNC/TC Ratio`,
    `BHIAvg_Vul` = Inv_BHIAvg * `RNC/TC Ratio`,
    `BHI_Vul` = Inv_BHI * `RNC/TC Ratio`,
    `BHISpecies_Vul` = Inv_BHISpecies * `RNC/TC Ratio`,
    `RNC/TC` = WBNCR/WBTC,
    BII_Vul_TC_Test = Inv_BII * `RNC/TC`, # Near-identical to the interpolated version
    DebtGDP = DebtGDP/100
  )

QData_I_CL <- QData_I_CL %>%
  rename(GDP = `WB GDP`,  ChinnIto = `Chinn-Ito`, 
    EPI = Inv_BDH, NDGAIN = Vulnerability,
    WB_Classification = `WB Classification`, IMF_Classification = `IMF Classification`)


# Re-scaling the weighted indices to 0-100 scale
QData_I_CL <- QData_I_CL %>%
  mutate(
    # Get the maximum values of the weighted indices
    max_BII_Vul_TC = max(BII_Vul_TC, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_BHIAvg_Vul = max(BHIAvg_Vul, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Re-scale to 0-100
    BII_Weighted = (BII_Vul_TC / max_BII_Vul_TC) * 100,
    BHI_Weighted = (BHIAvg_Vul / max_BHIAvg_Vul) * 100,
    
    # Remove the temporary maximum columns
    max_BII_Vul_TC = NULL,
    max_BHIAvg_Vul = NULL, 
    
    # Adjust the WGI indices
    WGI_CC = WGI_CC + 2.5,
    WGI_GE = WGI_GE + 2.5,
    WGI_RL = WGI_RL + 2.5,
    # Create combined institutional quality index as average of adjusted indices
    WGI_IQ = (WGI_CC + WGI_GE + WGI_RL) / 3
  )

# Standardise all main regression variables to unit within-country variance to facilitate cross-coefficient interpretation.
vars_to_standardize <- c(
  # Environmental / climate indicators
  "BII_Weighted", "BHI_Weighted", "EPI", "NDGAIN",
  # Macro controls used in IFE / QIFE
  "Inflation", "PB", "CA", "GDP", "DebtGDP",
  "FM_Depth", "WGI_RL", "CPI_Food"
)

# Calculate the within-country SD for each variable (demean by ISO3, then SD)
within_sds_map <- QData_I_CL %>%
  group_by(ISO3) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_to_standardize), ~ . - mean(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(vars_to_standardize), ~ sd(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  as.list()

# Divide each variable by its within-country SD (unit within-country variance)
QData_I_CL <- QData_I_CL %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_to_standardize),
                ~ . / within_sds_map[[cur_column()]]))

# Lag generation
QData_I_CL <- QData_I_CL %>%
      group_by(ISO3) %>%
      mutate(
        BII_Weighted_L1 = dplyr::lag(BII_Weighted, 1),
        BII_Weighted_L2 = dplyr::lag(BII_Weighted, 2),
        BHI_Weighted_L1 = dplyr::lag(BHI_Weighted, 1),
        BHI_Weighted_L2 = dplyr::lag(BHI_Weighted, 2),
        EPI_L1 = dplyr::lag(EPI, 1),
        EPI_L2 = dplyr::lag(EPI, 2),
        NDGAIN_L1 = dplyr::lag(NDGAIN, 1),
        NDGAIN_L2 = dplyr::lag(NDGAIN, 2),
        ER_t1 = dplyr::lead(ER, n = 1)
      ) %>%
      ungroup()

## Consider saving as csv at this stage

## Remove idiosyncratic outlier events (severe financial crisis, civil war, etc.) and observations with above-threshold leverage/studentized residuals.
QData_I_CL_clean <- QData_I_CL %>%
  filter(!(CountryYrQtr %in% c("GRC2010Q4","GRC2011Q1", "GRC2011Q2", "GRC2011Q3", "GRC2011Q4", "GRC2012Q1", "GRC2012Q2","GRC2012Q3", "GRC2012Q4","GRC2013Q1","GRC2013Q2","GRC2013Q3","GRC2013Q4", "GRC2015Q1", "GRC2015Q2", "IRL2015Q1", "IRL2016Q4", "IRL2017Q2","IRL2019Q2", "IRL2019Q4", "IRL2020Q1", "CHN2020Q1", "TUR2000Q1","TUR2000Q2","TUR2000Q3","TUR2000Q4", "TUR2001Q1", "TUR2001Q2","TUR2001Q3","TUR2001Q4","TUR2002Q1","TUR2002Q2" ,"TUR2002Q3", "TUR2002Q4", "TUR2003Q1","TUR2003Q2","TUR2003Q3","TUR2003Q4","TUR2004Q1","TUR2004Q2","TUR2004Q3","TUR2004Q4","TUR2008Q2","TUR2009Q1","TUR2018Q2","TUR2018Q3","TUR2018Q4" , "IDN2005Q4","IND2009Q3", "BGR2005Q4","BGR2007Q4","UGA2019Q4", "UGA2020Q1", "LKA2015Q1", "LKA2016Q1","ZMB2015Q4", "ZMB2016Q1","ZMB2016Q2","ZMB2016Q3","ZMB2019Q2","ZMB2019Q3","ZMB2019Q4","ZMB2020Q1","ZMB2020Q2","ZMB2020Q3","ZMB2020Q4")))
```

```{r Histograms}
       pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Risk Measure", values_to = "Value")) +  geom_histogram(aes(x = Value), 
                 binwidth = function(x) diff(range(x, na.rm = TRUE))/30,
                 fill = "darkgreen",  color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~`Risk Measure`, scales = "free") + theme_minimal() +
  labs( title = "Distribution of Climate and Nature Vulnerability Measures",
    x = "Value",
    y = "Frequency")
```

```{r Outlier Removal}

# We check for the outliers in the data by constructing simple linear regressions for each maturity. 
# Subsequently, we plot the leverage and studentized residuals to identify the outliers. 
# Only removing those with above threshold leverage (twice the mean leverage) and studentized residuals (twice the standard deviation of the studentized residuals).
# And where country-quarter observations lie in idiosyncratic event, e.g. severe financial crisis, civil war, etc.

# First, we filter out missing values for all relevant variables
model_data_ten <- QData_I_CL_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(TenYrSpread), !is.na(BII_Weighted), !is.na(Inflation), !is.na(PB),!is.na(CA), !is.na(GDP), !is.na(DebtGDP), !is.na(FM_Depth), !is.na(WGI_RL), !is.na(CPI_Food))

model_data_five <- QData_I_CL_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(FiveYrSpread), !is.na(BII_Weighted), !is.na(Inflation), !is.na(PB),!is.na(CA), !is.na(GDP), !is.na(DebtGDP), !is.na(FM_Depth), !is.na(WGI_RL), !is.na(CPI_Food))

model_data_two <- QData_I_CL_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(TwoYrSpread), !is.na(BII_Weighted), !is.na(Inflation), !is.na(PB),!is.na(CA), !is.na(GDP), !is.na(DebtGDP), !is.na(FM_Depth), !is.na(WGI_RL), !is.na(CPI_Food))

initial_modelTen <- lm(TenYrSpread ~ BII_Weighted + Inflation + PB + CA + GDP + DebtGDP + FM_Depth + WGI_RL + CPI_Food, 
                   data = model_data_ten)
initial_modelFive <- lm(FiveYrSpread ~ BII_Weighted  + Inflation + PB + CA + GDP + DebtGDP + FM_Depth + WGI_RL + CPI_Food, 
                   data = model_data_five)
initial_modelTwo <- lm(TwoYrSpread ~ BII_Weighted + Inflation + PB + CA + GDP + DebtGDP + FM_Depth + WGI_RL + CPI_Food, 
                   data = model_data_two)

# General diagnostics based on simple linear regression model. 
check_model(initial_modelTen)
check_model(initial_modelFive)
check_model(initial_modelTwo)

# Create diagnostic measures for Ten Year Spreads
initial_diagnosticsTen <- data.frame(
  CountryYrQtr = model_data_ten$CountryYrQtr, Leverage = hatvalues(initial_modelTen),
  Studentized_Residuals = rstudent(initial_modelTen)
) %>%
  mutate(
    high_leverage = Leverage > 2 * mean(Leverage),
    high_residual = abs(Studentized_Residuals) > 2,  point_type = case_when(
      high_leverage & high_residual ~ "Both",  high_leverage ~ "High Leverage",
      high_residual ~ "High Residual", TRUE ~ "Normal"
    )
  )

initial_diagnosticsFive <- data.frame(
  CountryYrQtr = model_data_five$CountryYrQtr, Leverage = hatvalues(initial_modelFive),
  Studentized_Residuals = rstudent(initial_modelFive)
) %>%
  mutate(
    high_leverage = Leverage > 2 * mean(Leverage),
    high_residual = abs(Studentized_Residuals) > 2,  point_type = case_when(
      high_leverage & high_residual ~ "Both",  high_leverage ~ "High Leverage",
      high_residual ~ "High Residual", TRUE ~ "Normal"
    )
  )

initial_diagnosticsTwo <- data.frame(
  CountryYrQtr = model_data_two$CountryYrQtr, Leverage = hatvalues(initial_modelTwo),
  Studentized_Residuals = rstudent(initial_modelTwo)
) %>%
  mutate(
    high_leverage = Leverage > 2 * mean(Leverage),
    high_residual = abs(Studentized_Residuals) > 2,  point_type = case_when(
      high_leverage & high_residual ~ "Both",  high_leverage ~ "High Leverage",
      high_residual ~ "High Residual", TRUE ~ "Normal"
    )
  )

# Create a combined plot for all three spreads
ggplot(initial_diagnosticsTen, aes(x = Leverage, y = Studentized_Residuals)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = point_type), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(initial_diagnosticsTen, point_type != "Normal"),aes(label = CountryYrQtr),size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2 * mean(initial_diagnosticsTen$Leverage), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Both" = "red", "High Leverage" = "orange", "High Residual" = "blue", "Normal" = "grey")) +
  labs( title = "Outlier and Leverage Diagnostics for Ten Year Spreads",
    x = "Leverage", y = "Studentized Residuals",
    color = "Diagnostic Type",caption = "Red lines indicate thresholds for outliers") +
  theme_minimal() + scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette("Moonrise3"))

ggplot(initial_diagnosticsFive, aes(x = Leverage, y = Studentized_Residuals)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = point_type), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(initial_diagnosticsFive, point_type != "Normal"),aes(label = CountryYrQtr),size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2 * mean(initial_diagnosticsFive$Leverage), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Both" = "red", "High Leverage" = "orange", "High Residual" = "blue", "Normal" = "grey")) +
  labs( title = "Outlier and Leverage Diagnostics for Five Year Spreads", 
    x = "Leverage", y = "Studentized Residuals",
    color = "Diagnostic Type",caption = "Red lines indicate thresholds for outliers") +
  theme_minimal() + scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette("Moonrise3"))

ggplot(initial_diagnosticsTwo, aes(x = Leverage, y = Studentized_Residuals)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = point_type), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(initial_diagnosticsTwo, point_type != "Normal"),aes(label = CountryYrQtr),size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2 * mean(initial_diagnosticsTwo$Leverage), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Both" = "red", "High Leverage" = "orange", "High Residual" = "blue", "Normal" = "grey")) +
  labs( title = "Outlier and Leverage Diagnostics for Two Year Spreads",
    x = "Leverage", y = "Studentized Residuals",
    color = "Diagnostic Type",caption = "Red lines indicate thresholds for outliers") +
  theme_minimal() + scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette("Moonrise3"))
```

```{r Maps}
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Fix mismatching country codes between world map package and ISO3 naming convention.
world <- world %>%
  mutate(iso_a3 = case_when(
    name == "France" ~ "FRA",
    name == "Norway" ~ "NOR",
    TRUE ~ iso_a3
  ))

# Prepare data for mapping (2015-2020 averages)
map_data <- QData_Final %>%
  dplyr::filter(Year >= 2015 & Year <= 2020) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ISO3) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    BII_Weighted = mean(BII_Weighted, na.rm = TRUE),
    EPI = mean(EPI, na.rm = TRUE),
    Inv_BII = mean(Inv_BII, na.rm = TRUE),
    BHI_Weighted = mean(BHI_Weighted, na.rm = TRUE),
    NDGAIN = mean(NDGAIN, na.rm = TRUE),
    TwoYrSpread = mean(TwoYrSpread, na.rm = TRUE),
    FiveYrSpread = mean(FiveYrSpread, na.rm = TRUE),
    TenYrSpread = mean(TenYrSpread, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Create base map theme
map_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()
  )

# Function to create maps
create_map <- function(data, variable, title, color_option = "plasma", legend_name = NULL) {
  ggplot(data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[variable]])) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = color_option,
      na.value = "grey80",
      name = legend_name %||% variable
    ) +
    map_theme +
    labs(
      title = paste("Global Distribution of", title),
      subtitle = "Average values 2015-2020"
    )
}

# Join with world map data
world_data <- world %>%
  left_join(map_data, by = c("iso_a3" = "ISO3"))

# Create maps
map_specs <- list(
  list("BII_Weighted", "Weighted Biodiversity Degradation (BII)", "plasma", "Weighted\nBiodiversity\nIntactness Index"),
  list("Inv_BII", "Biodiversity Intactness Index", "plasma", "Biodiversity\nIntactness Index"),
  list("BHI_Weighted", "Weighted Biodiversity Degradation (BHI)", "plasma", "Weighted\nBiodiversity\nHabitat Index"),
  list("EPI", "Environmental Performance Index - Biodiversity and Habitat", "plasma", "EPI\nBiodiversity and Habitat"),
  list("NDGAIN", "Climate Vulnerability", "plasma", "ND-GAIN\nClimate\nVulnerability"),
  list("TenYrSpread", "10-Year Sovereign Borrowing Costs, Vanilla Debt", "plasma", "10-Year\nYield Spread"),
  list("FiveYrSpread", "5-Year Sovereign Borrowing Costs, Vanilla Debt", "plasma", "5-Year\nYield Spread"),
  list("TwoYrSpread", "2-Year Sovereign Borrowing Costs, Vanilla Debt", "plasma", "2-Year\nYield Spread")
)

# Generate all maps
maps <- lapply(map_specs, function(spec) {
  create_map(world_data, spec[[1]], spec[[2]], spec[[3]], spec[[4]])
})
maps[[1]]  # For BII_Weighted map
maps[[2]]  # For Inv_BII map
maps[[3]]  # For BHI_Weighted map
maps[[4]]  # For EPI map
maps[[5]]  # For NDGAIN map
maps[[6]]  # For TenYrSpread map
maps[[7]]  # For FiveYrSpread map
maps[[8]]  # For TwoYrSpread map
```

```{r Line Plots}
## Line plots: 
# 1. Prepare data for time series plots
# First we select the key variables, then pivot to a long format, and calculate quarterly means.
# Individual country-level data (for thin background lines)
# Second, we remove the countries we drop anyway and use QData_I_CL_Desc_Clean as temporary data frame for visualisations.
QData_I_CL_Desc_Clean <- QData_I_CL %>% 
  filter(!(ISO3 %in% c("NAM","NGA","TUN"))) # Ensure is aligned with outlier removal step. 

time_series_individual_q <- QData_I_CL_Desc_Clean %>%
  filter(IMF_Classification %in% c("AE", "EMDE"), Year >= 2001) %>%
  select(YearQtr, IMF_Classification, ISO3, BII_Weighted, BHI_Weighted, EPI, NDGAIN, TenYrSpread, FiveYrSpread, TwoYrSpread, FM_Depth) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(YearQtr, IMF_Classification, ISO3),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# Group mean data (for thick overlay lines)
time_series_data_q <- time_series_individual_q %>%
  group_by(YearQtr, IMF_Classification, Variable) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 2. Define a consistent theme for the plots
ts_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )

# 3. Plot Environmental Variables using facet_wrap
environmental_vars_q <- c("BII_Weighted", "BHI_Weighted", "EPI", "NDGAIN")

# Define descriptive labels for the facets
env_plot_labels <- c(
  `BII_Weighted` = "Weighted Biodiversity Intactness Index",
  `BHI_Weighted` = "Weighted Biodiversity and Habitat Index",
  `EPI` = "EPI: Biodiversity and Habitat Sub-Index",
  `NDGAIN` = "ND-GAIN Climate Vulnerability"
)
mark_plot_labels <- c(
  `TenYrSpread` = "10-Year Spread",
  `FiveYrSpread` = "5-Year Spread",
  `TwoYrSpread` = "2-Year Spread", 
  `FM_Depth` = "Capital Market Depth"
)

# Prepare individual data for environmental variables
env_individual <- time_series_individual_q %>%
  filter(Variable %in% environmental_vars_q) %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = names(env_plot_labels), labels = env_plot_labels))

# Prepare mean data for environmental variables  
env_mean <- time_series_data_q %>%
  filter(Variable %in% environmental_vars_q) %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = names(env_plot_labels), labels = env_plot_labels))

# Filter env_mean for Q1 only (annual data points pre-interpolation)
env_mean_q1 <- env_mean %>%
  mutate(Quarter = as.numeric(format(YearQtr, "%q"))) %>%
  filter(Quarter == 1)

# Prepare endpoint labels for environmental variables - individual country labels
env_labels <- env_individual %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  group_by(ISO3, IMF_Classification, Variable) %>%
  filter(YearQtr == max(YearQtr)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Get color palette
palette_colors <- wes_palette("Moonrise3")

environmental_plot_q <- ggplot() +
  # Individual country lines (thin, transparent background)
  geom_line(data = env_individual,
            aes(x = YearQtr, y = Value, group = interaction(ISO3, IMF_Classification), 
                color = IMF_Classification),
            linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
  # Mean lines (thick overlay)
  geom_line(data = env_mean,
            aes(x = YearQtr, y = Mean_Value, color = IMF_Classification, 
                group = IMF_Classification),
            linewidth = 1.5) +
  # Dot markers on Q1 only to show original annual data points
  geom_point(data = env_mean_q1,
             aes(x = YearQtr, y = Mean_Value, color = IMF_Classification),
             size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  # Labels at end of individual country lines
  geom_text_repel(data = env_labels,
                  aes(x = as.numeric(YearQtr), y = Value, label = ISO3, 
                      color = IMF_Classification),
                  nudge_x = 0.5, direction = "y", hjust = 0, segment.size = 0.2,
                  size = 2, max.overlaps = 5,
                  box.padding = 0.2, point.padding = 0.1,
                  force = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  ts_theme + 
  scale_color_manual(values = palette_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Year-Quarter",
    y = "Value",
    color = "IMF Classification" 
  ) +
  scale_x_yearqtr(format = "%Y-Q%q", n = 8, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.12))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

print(environmental_plot_q)

# 4. Plot Market Variables using facet_wrap
```

```{r Descriptive Statistics}
#2.: This section creates the descriptive tables and summary statistics
# Correlation tests 
correlation_data <- as.matrix(QData_Final[c("BII_Weighted", "BHI_Weighted","EPI", "NDGAIN","TwoYrSpread","FiveYrSpread","TenYrSpread","Inflation", "CA", "PB","GDP", "DebtGDP", "CPI_Food", "FM_Depth","WGI_RL")])
# Create a copy of correlation data with renamed columns for labeling
correlation_data_labeled <- correlation_data
colnames(correlation_data_labeled) <- c("Weighted BII", "Weighted BHI", "EPI", "Climate Vulnerability", "2-Year Spread", "5-Year Spread", "10-Year Spread", "Inflation", "Current Account", "Primary Balance","GDP-Growth", "Debt-to-GDP Ratio", "CPI Food", "Cap. Mark. Depth","Rule of Law")
# Calculate correlation with labeled data
correlation_results_labeled <- rcorr(correlation_data_labeled, type = "spearman")
# Create a visualization of the correlations with proper labels
ggcorrplot(
  correlation_results_labeled$r, p.mat = correlation_results_labeled$P, 
  type = "lower", lab = TRUE, insig = "blank", sig.level = 0.05,
  title = "Spearman Correlation Coefficients")


# Generate summary statistics by IMF Classification
variables <- c("TenYrSpread", "FiveYrSpread", "TwoYrSpread", "NDGAIN", 
              "BII_Weighted", "BHI_Weighted", "EPI", "Inflation",
              "GDP", "CA", "PB", "DebtGDP", "CPI_Food", "FM_Depth","WGI_RL")

# First, calculate the average within-country standard deviation for each group
within_sds <- QData_Final %>%
  filter(IMF_Classification %in% c("AE", "EMDE")) %>%
  group_by(IMF_Classification, ISO3) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(variables), ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_sd"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(IMF_Classification) %>%
  summarise(across(ends_with("_sd"), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate N (number of countries) and Avg_T (average time periods per country) for each variable
panel_dims <- QData_Final %>%
  filter(IMF_Classification %in% c("AE", "EMDE")) %>%
  group_by(IMF_Classification) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(variables),
                   list(
                     # N = number of unique countries with non-NA values
                     N = ~n_distinct(ISO3[!is.na(.)]),
                     # Avg_T = average number of observations per country
                     Avg_T = ~{
                       obs_per_country <- tapply(!is.na(.), ISO3, sum)
                       mean(obs_per_country[obs_per_country > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
                     }
                   ),
                   .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
            .groups = "drop")

# Calculate the other statistics (n, mean, min, max) for each group
other_stats <- QData_Final %>%
  filter(IMF_Classification %in% c("AE", "EMDE")) %>%
  group_by(IMF_Classification) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(variables),
                   list(n = ~sum(!is.na(.)), 
                        mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
                        min = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
                        max = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE)),
                   .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
            .groups = "drop")

# Join all summary tables together
descriptive_stats <- other_stats %>%
  left_join(within_sds, by = "IMF_Classification") %>%
  left_join(panel_dims, by = "IMF_Classification")

# Reshape the data for presentation

    cols = -IMF_Classification,

    Variable == "TenYrSpread"  ~ "Ten Year Spread",

    Variable == "FM_Depth"  ~ "Capital Market Depth",

  )) %>%
  # Reorder columns: Variable, n, N, Avg_T, mean, sd, min, max
  select(IMF_Classification, Variable, n, N, Avg_T, mean, sd, min, max)

# Create separate tables for AE and EMDE
```

## IFE Models

```{r Interactive Fixed Effects}
# 1. Prepare Base Data
# Create a specific dataframe for IFE from QData_Final
QData_IFE <- as.data.frame(QData_Final)
# Convert YearQtr to numeric factor as required by interFE (Note, that this is not required for QIFE, it's a package issue)
QData_IFE$YearQtr <- as.numeric(as.factor(QData_IFE$YearQtr)) 
QData_IFE$ISO3 <- as.character(QData_IFE$ISO3)

# 2. Manual test for one specification to check for any previous errors. 
 cols_needed <- c("TwoYrSpread", "BII_Weighted_L1", "Inflation", "PB", "CA", "GDP", "DebtGDP", "FM_Depth", "WGI_RL", "ISO3", "YearQtr", "CPI_Food")
QData_IFE_Test <- QData_IFE[cols_needed]
# 3. Drop rows with ANY missing values in these columns
QData_IFE_Test <- na.omit(QData_IFE_Test)
TwoBII_IFE <- interFE(TwoYrSpread ~ BII_Weighted_L1 + Inflation + PB + CA + GDP + DebtGDP + FM_Depth + WGI_RL + CPI_Food, data = QData_IFE_Test, index = c("ISO3", "YearQtr"),  r =2,  force = "unit", nboots = 150, seed = 1)

## Loop across all IFE specifications
# interFE() uses argument r; object names use k to avoid confusion with R-squared.
dependent_vars   <- c("TwoYrSpread", "FiveYrSpread", "TenYrSpread")
independent_vars <- c("BII_Weighted_L1", "BHI_Weighted_L1", "NDGAIN_L1", "EPI_L1")
controls         <- c("Inflation", "PB", "CA", "GDP", "DebtGDP",
                      "FM_Depth", "WGI_RL", "CPI_Food")

run_ife_grid <- function(k_factors) {
  results <- list()
  for (dv in dependent_vars) {
    for (iv in independent_vars) {
      model_name <- paste(dv, iv, sep = "_")
      message(paste("Running IFE k=", k_factors, ":", model_name))

      formula_str <- paste(dv, "~", iv, "+", paste(controls, collapse = " + "))

      ldv_cols <- c(dv)
      if (grepl(paste0(dv, "_L1"), formula_str, fixed = TRUE)) {
        ldv_cols <- c(ldv_cols, paste0(dv, "_L1"))
      }
      if (grepl(paste0(dv, "_L2"), formula_str, fixed = TRUE)) {
        ldv_cols <- c(ldv_cols, paste0(dv, "_L2"))
      }

      cols_needed <- c(ldv_cols, iv, controls, "ISO3", "YearQtr")

      missing_cols <- setdiff(cols_needed, names(QData_IFE))
      if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
        warning(paste("Missing columns for", model_name, ":",
                      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "- skipping"))
        next
      }

      data_subset <- na.omit(QData_IFE[, cols_needed])
      if (nrow(data_subset) < 50) {
        warning(paste("Insufficient data for", model_name, "- skipping"))
        next
      }

      fit <- tryCatch({
        interFE(
          formula = as.formula(formula_str),
          data    = data_subset,
          index   = c("ISO3", "YearQtr"),
          r       = k_factors,
          force   = "unit",
          nboots  = 1000,
          se      = TRUE,
          seed    = 1,
          normalize = FALSE
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        message(paste("Error in", model_name, ":", e$message)); NULL
      })

      if (!is.null(fit)) {
        results[[model_name]] <- fit
        # print(paste("--- Results for", model_name, "(k=", k_factors, ") ---"))
        # print(fit$est.table)
      }
    }
  }
  results
}

ife_results_k0_list <- run_ife_grid(0)
ife_results_k1_list <- run_ife_grid(1)
ife_results_k2_list <- run_ife_grid(2)

saveRDS(ife_results_k0_list, file = "ife_results_k0.rds")
saveRDS(ife_results_k1_list, file = "ife_results_k1.rds")
saveRDS(ife_results_k2_list, file = "ife_results_k2.rds")

# Reload helper (use after a full run, or skip the loops above)
ife_results_k0_list <- readRDS("ife_results_k0.rds")
ife_results_k1_list <- readRDS("ife_results_k1.rds")
ife_results_k2_list <- readRDS("ife_results_k2.rds")


# 5) Extract ALL Coefficients from IFE Results 
extract_all_ife_coefficients <- function(ife_list) {
  all_coefs <- list()
  
  for (model_name in names(ife_list)) {
    fit <- ife_list[[model_name]]
    
    if (is.null(fit) || is.null(fit$est.table)) {
      message(paste("Skipping", model_name, "- no coefficients found."))
      next
    }
    
    coefs <- fit$est.table
    
    # Identify DV from model name (reuse variables already defined in loop)
    dv_name <- NA
    if (grepl("TwoYrSpread", model_name)) dv_name <- "TwoYrSpread"
    if (grepl("FiveYrSpread", model_name)) dv_name <- "FiveYrSpread"
    if (grepl("TenYrSpread", model_name)) dv_name <- "TenYrSpread"
    
    # Identify IV from model name (reuse variables already defined in loop)
    # Note: Handle both "Vulnerability" (old saved results) and "NDGAIN" (current name)
    iv_name <- NA
    if (grepl("BII_Weighted", model_name)) iv_name <- "BII_Weighted_L1"
    if (grepl("BHI_Weighted", model_name)) iv_name <- "BHI_Weighted_L1"
    if (grepl("NDGAIN", model_name) || grepl("Vulnerability", model_name)) iv_name <- "NDGAIN_L1"
    if (grepl("EPI", model_name)) iv_name <- "EPI_L1"
    
    # Extract ALL coefficients (including controls, not just main IVs)
    for (var_name in rownames(coefs)) {
      est <- coefs[var_name, "Coef"]
      se <- coefs[var_name, "S.E."]
      pval <- coefs[var_name, "p.value"]
      ci_lower <- coefs[var_name, "CI.lower"]
      ci_upper <- coefs[var_name, "CI.upper"]
      
      # Significance stars
      sig <- case_when(
        pval < 0.01 ~ "***",
        pval < 0.05 ~ "**",
        pval < 0.1 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
      
      all_coefs[[length(all_coefs) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Model = model_name,
        Dependent_Variable = dv_name,
        Independent_Variable = iv_name,
        Variable = var_name,
        Estimate = est,
        Std_Error = se,
        P_Value = pval,
        CI_Lower = ci_lower,
        CI_Upper = ci_upper,
        Significance = sig,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  
  return(do.call(rbind, all_coefs))
}
# Extract all coefficients into a single dataframe
ife_results_k2 <- extract_all_ife_coefficients(ife_results_k2_list)
ife_results_k1 <- extract_all_ife_coefficients(ife_results_k1_list)
ife_results_k0 <- extract_all_ife_coefficients(ife_results_k0_list)

# Adjusted R^2 is not natively computed from the interFE package, we proceed manually:
# Function to calculate within R² for all IFE models
calculate_ife_within_r2 <- function(ife_list) {
  r2_results <- data.frame()
  for (model_name in names(ife_list)) {
    fit <- ife_list[[model_name]]
    
    if (is.null(fit) || is.null(fit$est.table)) {
      message(paste("Skipping", model_name, "- no coefficients found."))
      next
    }
    Y_mat    <- fit$dat.Y
    res_mat  <- fit$residuals
    # 1. Mask real observations (exclude padded zero-zero cells)
    obs <- !is.na(Y_mat) & !is.na(res_mat)
    obs <- obs & (Y_mat != 0 | res_mat != 0)
    # 2. Country-demean Y within observed cells
    Y_within <- Y_mat
    for (j in seq_len(ncol(Y_mat))) {
      idx_j <- obs[, j]
      if (any(idx_j)) {
        mu_j <- mean(Y_mat[idx_j, j], na.rm = TRUE)   # mean for country j over observed t
        Y_within[idx_j, j] <- Y_mat[idx_j, j] - mu_j  # demean within country
        Y_within[!idx_j, j] <- NA                     # keep non-obs out
      } else {
        Y_within[, j] <- NA
      }
    }
    # 3. Calculate panel dimensions
    # Count valid observations per country (columns)
    T_per_country <- colSums(obs, na.rm = TRUE)  # Number of time periods per country
    n_countries <- sum(T_per_country > 0)         # Number of countries with at least one observation
    avg_T <- mean(T_per_country[T_per_country > 0], na.rm = TRUE)  # Average T across countries
    
    # 4. Vectorise over observed cells
    y_within_vec <- as.numeric(Y_within[obs])
    res_vec      <- as.numeric(res_mat[obs])
    
    # 5. Within TSS and RSS
    TSS_within <- sum((y_within_vec - mean(y_within_vec, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    RSS        <- sum(res_vec^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (TSS_within > 0) {
      R2_within <- 1 - RSS / TSS_within
      
      n_obs <- length(y_within_vec)
      n_covars <- nrow(fit$est.table) - 1  # excluding intercept
      if (n_obs > n_covars + 1) {
        Adj_R2_within <- 1 - (1 - R2_within) * ((n_obs - 1) / (n_obs - n_covars - 1))
      } else {Adj_R2_within <- NA}
      r2_results <- rbind(r2_results, data.frame(
        Model = model_name,
        R_Squared_Within = R2_within,
        Adj_R_Squared_Within = Adj_R2_within,
        N_Obs = n_obs,
        N_Countries = n_countries,
        Avg_T = avg_T,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE))}}
  return(r2_results)
}

# Calculate within R² for all models (cycle through factor specification, e.g. k1, k2, k0)
ife_within_r2_k2 <- calculate_ife_within_r2(ife_results_k2_list) # and for k1 and k0
print(ife_within_r2_k2)

# Merge R² and panel dimensions into ife_results_k1 (k0, or k2) dataframe
ife_results_k2 <- ife_results_k2 %>%
  left_join(ife_within_r2_k2 %>% select(Model, R_Squared_Within, Adj_R_Squared_Within, N_Obs, N_Countries, Avg_T), by = "Model")
print(ife_results_k2, max = 4000) # and cycle through factor specification, e.g. k1, k2, k0. Visualised in latex format in the paper. 

```

```{r PCA for Factors}
# Standardize EACH variable separately BEFORE pivoting 
macro_base <- QData_Final %>%
  dplyr::select(YearQtr, K1, K2, VIX, FFR, Oil, GBI_EM_Global_USD, Commodity, MSCI) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(YearQtr, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%

# Standardize each column separately (z-scores)
standardize <- function(x) (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

# INVERT FACTOR SIGNS for display (so correlations are more intuitive)
# PCA factors are identified up to sign rotation (Bai & Ng, 2008), so we flip
# K1 and K2 to show positive correlation with bond prices (GBI-EM)
macro_standardized <- macro_base %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Invert factor signs for display purposes only
    K1_inverted = -K1,  K2_inverted = -K2,
    # Standardize all variables
    dplyr::across(c(K1_inverted, K2_inverted, VIX, FFR, Oil, GBI_EM_Global_USD, Commodity, MSCI), standardize, .names = "{.col}_std"))

# Create nice labels for variables
var_labels <- c(
  "VIX" = "VIX (Volatility Index)", 
  "FFR" = "Federal Funds Rate", 
  "Oil" = "Oil Price (Brent)", 
  "GBI_EM_Global_USD" = "GBI-EM Global (USD)",
  "Commodity" = "Commodity Price Index",
  "MSCI" = "MSCI World Index")

# Function to aggregate plots of factor vis-a-vis macro trends
create_factor_plot <- function(data, factor_name, inverted = TRUE) {
  # Use inverted factors for display
  factor_std_col <- if(inverted) paste0(factor_name, "_inverted_std") else paste0(factor_name, "_std")
  factor_orig_col <- if(inverted) paste0(factor_name, "_inverted") else factor_name
  # Pivot the macro variables (standardized)
  macro_long <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(YearQtr, all_of(factor_std_col), 
                  VIX_std, FFR_std, Oil_std, GBI_EM_Global_USD_std, Commodity_std, MSCI_std) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(VIX_std, FFR_std, Oil_std, GBI_EM_Global_USD_std, Commodity_std, MSCI_std),
      names_to = "Macro_Variable",
      values_to = "Macro_Value_std"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Macro_Variable_Clean = gsub("_std$", "", Macro_Variable),
      Macro_Label = factor(Macro_Variable_Clean, levels = names(var_labels), labels = var_labels),
      Factor_std = .data[[factor_std_col]]
    )
  # Calculate correlations using inverted (non-standardized) values
  correlations <- data %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      VIX = cor(.data[[factor_orig_col]], VIX, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
      FFR = cor(.data[[factor_orig_col]], FFR, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
      Oil = cor(.data[[factor_orig_col]], Oil, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
      GBI_EM_Global_USD = cor(.data[[factor_orig_col]], GBI_EM_Global_USD, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
      Commodity = cor(.data[[factor_orig_col]], Commodity, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
      MSCI = cor(.data[[factor_orig_col]], MSCI, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Macro_Variable_Clean", values_to = "cor") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Macro_Label = factor(Macro_Variable_Clean, levels = names(var_labels), labels = var_labels),
      cor_label = paste0("ρ = ", sprintf("%.2f", cor))
    )
  # Create the plot with proper YearQtr formatting
  p <- ggplot(macro_long, aes(x = YearQtr)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Macro_Value_std, color = "Macro Variable"), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Factor_std, color = paste("PCA Factor", factor_name)), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_label(data = correlations, 
               aes(x = as.yearqtr("2001 Q1"), y = Inf, label = cor_label),
               hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2, size = 3, fill = "white", alpha = 0.8,
               label.size = 0, fontface = "bold") +
    facet_wrap(~ Macro_Label, ncol = 3, scales = "fixed") +
    scale_x_yearqtr(format = "%Y Q%q") +  # Format x-axis as "2000 Q1"
    scale_color_manual(values = setNames(c("steelblue", "red"), 
                                         c("Macro Variable", paste("PCA Factor", factor_name)))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3.5, 3.5)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("PCA Factor", factor_name, "vs. Global Macro Dynamics"),
      subtitle = "Validating that the factor captures common shocks (both series standardized to z-scores)",
      x = "Quarter",
      y = "Standardized Value",
      color = "",
      caption = "ρ = Pearson correlation."
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgray", color = NA),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  return(list(plot = p, correlations = correlations))
}

# Create and display plots for both factors
k1_results <- create_factor_plot(macro_standardized, "K1", inverted = TRUE)
print(k1_results$correlations %>% dplyr::select(Macro_Label, cor))

k2_results <- create_factor_plot(macro_standardized, "K2", inverted = TRUE)
print(k2_results$correlations %>% dplyr::select(Macro_Label, cor))
print(k2_results$plot)
```

```{r Linear Quantile Mixture Model}
# Add PCA Factors to QData_QIFE
# Now join to QData_QIFE (both have standard YearQtr string)
QData_QIFE <- QData_Final # Ensure QData_Final contains the factors from PCA_factor_df, if not, join again: 
# E,g. QData_QIFE <- QData_QIFE %>%   left_join(PCA_factor_df, by = "YearQtr") # And ensure YearQtr is not numeric


# This section has 3 subsections; 1) A manual test of lqmix for one specification and quantile, 
# 2) A loop across all specifications, quantiles, factors, and groups, stored separately (requires manual update of qife_results_df)
# 3) Ggplot of the results using qife_results_df, remember to set it to the corresponding group number of interest

# 1) Manual test
# Explanation of the main arguments in the linear quantile mixture model, i.e. QIFE:
# randomTC = ~ 1 + K1 (+ K2)
#   ~ 1      : Random Intercept (alpha_i) -> Country (or group)-specific constant
#   + K1/K2  : Random Slopes on PCA factors (lambda_i * K_t) -> Country (or group)-specific sensitivity to global cycle
# Note: lqmix estimates one quantile at a time; loop runs 5 quantiles x 2 factor specs x 3 DVs x 4 IVs ≈ 120 models, with R = 500 takes around 10 hours to run.

QIFE_Test <- lqmix(
  formula = TwoYrSpread ~ BII_Weighted_L1 + Inflation + PB + CA + GDP + DebtGDP + FM_Depth + WGI_RL + CPI_Food,      
  randomTC = ~ 1 + K1 + K2,          # Time-Constant Random Coefficients (group-specific loadings)
  group = "ISO3",                                 # Grouping variable (Country) - must be string
  time = "YearQtr",                               # Time variable - must be string
  G = 4,                                          # Number of mixture components for TC random coefficients
  data = QData_QIFE,
  qtl = 0.25,                                      # Quantile to estimate (10th percentile)
  se = TRUE,                                      # Compute standard errors
  R = 500,                                        # Number of bootstrap samples for SE
  verbose = TRUE)
summary(QIFE_Test)

# 2) Loop through all quantile IFE specifications
# Define specifications
dependent_vars <- c("TwoYrSpread", "FiveYrSpread", "TenYrSpread")
independent_vars <- c("BII_Weighted_L1", "BHI_Weighted_L1", "EPI_L1", "NDGAIN_L1")
controls <- c("Inflation", "PB", "CA", "GDP", "DebtGDP", "FM_Depth", "WGI_RL", "CPI_Food")
quantiles <- c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9)
num_factors <- c(1, 2)  # k = 1 and k = 2
R_boot <- 500

# Function runs QIFE for all specifications and stores results in a nested list: qife_results[[dv]][[iv]][[k]][[quantile]]
run_qife_grid <- function(n_groups) {
  results <- list()
  for (dv in dependent_vars) {
    results[[dv]] <- list()
    dv_abbrev <- gsub("YrSpread", "", dv)

    for (iv in independent_vars) {
      results[[dv]][[iv]] <- list()

      for (k in num_factors) {
        results[[dv]][[iv]][[paste0("k", k)]] <- list()
        randomTC_formula <- if (k == 1) ~ 1 + K1 else ~ 1 + K1 + K2

        for (qtl in quantiles) {
          iv_abbrev <- gsub("_Weighted_L1|_L1", "", iv)
          model_name <- paste0(dv_abbrev, "_", iv_abbrev, "_K", k, "_G", n_groups,
                               "_q", gsub("\\.", "", as.character(qtl)))
          message(paste("Running:", model_name))

          formula_obj <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", iv, "+",
                                          paste(controls, collapse = " + ")))

          fit <- tryCatch({
            lqmix(
              formula = formula_obj,
              randomTC = randomTC_formula,
              group = "ISO3",
              time = "YearQtr",
              G = n_groups,
              data = QData_QIFE,
              qtl = qtl,
              se = TRUE,
              R = R_boot,
              verbose = TRUE
            )
          }, error = function(e) {
            message(paste("Error in", model_name, ":", e$message))
            return(NULL)
          })

          if (!is.null(fit)) {
            results[[dv]][[iv]][[paste0("k", k)]][[as.character(qtl)]] <- fit
            message(paste("Completed:", model_name))
          } else {
            message(paste("Failed:", model_name))
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  results
}
# Run QIFE for factors 1, 2, all quantiles, EVs and DVs, but separately for each number of groups (G=3, 4, or 5)
qife_results_G3 <- run_qife_grid(3)
qife_results_G4 <- run_qife_grid(4)
qife_results_G5 <- run_qife_grid(5)
# Save results accordingly to disk. 
#saveRDS(qife_results_G3, file = "qife_results_G3.rds")

# Reload stored results (use after a full run, or skip the loops above). On a MBP 2023 M3 Pro, it takes > 10 hours to run the full loops, use a HPC if available. 
qife_results_G3 <- readRDS("qife_results_G3.rds")
qife_results_G4 <- readRDS("qife_results_G4.rds")

## Extract Coefficients from Quantile IFE Results for Visualization
extract_qife_coefficients <- function(qife_results_list, g = NA) {
  all_coefs <- list()
  for (dv in names(qife_results_list)) {
    for (iv in names(qife_results_list[[dv]])) {
      for (k_nm in names(qife_results_list[[dv]][[iv]])) {
        for (qtl_str in names(qife_results_list[[dv]][[iv]][[k_nm]])) {
          model <- qife_results_list[[dv]][[iv]][[k_nm]][[qtl_str]]
          if (is.null(model)) next

          model_summary <- tryCatch(summary(model), error = function(e) {
            message(paste("Error calling summary for", dv, iv, k_nm, qtl_str, ":", e$message))
            return(NULL)
          })

          coef_table <- NULL
          if (!is.null(model_summary) && !is.null(model_summary$fix)) {
            coef_table <- model_summary$fix
          }
          if (is.null(coef_table) && !is.null(model$betaf) && !is.null(model$se.betaf)) {
            coef_table <- cbind(Estimate = model$betaf, `St.Error` = model$se.betaf)
          }
          if (is.null(coef_table)) {
            message(paste("Could not find coefficients for", dv, iv, k_nm, qtl_str))
            next
          }

          if (is.vector(coef_table)) {
            coef_table <- matrix(coef_table, ncol = 1,
                                 dimnames = list(names(coef_table), "Estimate"))
          }

          sigma_e <- NA
          if (!is.null(model_summary) && !is.null(model_summary$sigma.e)) {
            sigma_e <- model_summary$sigma.e
          } else if (!is.null(model$sigma.e)) {
            sigma_e <- model$sigma.e
          }

          if (iv %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
            all_coefs[[length(all_coefs) + 1]] <- data.frame(
              dependent = dv,
              independent = iv,
              quantile = as.numeric(qtl_str),
              k = as.numeric(gsub("^k|^r", "", k_nm)),
              G = g,
              estimate = coef_table[iv, 1],
              std.error = if (ncol(coef_table) >= 2) coef_table[iv, 2] else NA,
              p.value = if (ncol(coef_table) >= 4) coef_table[iv, 4] else NA,
              sigma.e = sigma_e,
              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )
          } else {
            message(paste("IV", iv, "not found in coefficient table for", dv, k_nm, qtl_str,
                          "- Available:", paste(rownames(coef_table), collapse = ", ")))
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (length(all_coefs) == 0) {
    warning("No coefficients extracted from qife_results")
    return(data.frame())
  }

  do.call(rbind, all_coefs)
}

qife_3group_coefs_df <- extract_qife_coefficients(qife_results_G3, g = 3)
qife_4group_coefs_df <- extract_qife_coefficients(qife_results_G4, g = 4)
qife_5group_coefs_df <- extract_qife_coefficients(qife_results_G5, g = 5)

saveRDS(qife_3group_coefs_df, file = "qife_3group_coefs_df.rds")
saveRDS(qife_4group_coefs_df, file = "qife_4group_coefs_df.rds")
saveRDS(qife_5group_coefs_df, file = "qife_5group_coefs_df.rds")

# Reload coef tables without re-estimating
qife_3group_coefs_df <- readRDS("qife_3group_coefs_df.rds")
qife_4group_coefs_df <- readRDS("qife_4group_coefs_df.rds")
qife_5group_coefs_df <- readRDS("qife_5group_coefs_df.rds")

# Set G of interest for tables/plots (headline spec: G = 4)
# qife_coefs_df <- qife_3group_coefs_df
qife_coefs_df <- qife_4group_coefs_df
# qife_coefs_df <- qife_5group_coefs_df

# 3) Plot QIFE results: 
if (nrow(qife_coefs_df) == 0) {
  warning("Could not extract coefficients from qife_results. Check model structure.")
} else {
  qife_coefs_df <- qife_coefs_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p.value = ifelse(is.na(p.value) & !is.na(std.error) & std.error > 0,
                       2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(estimate / std.error))), p.value),
      significance = case_when(
        !is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.01 ~ "***",
        !is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.05 ~ "**",
        !is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.1  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      dependent_label = factor(dependent,
        levels = c("TwoYrSpread", "FiveYrSpread", "TenYrSpread"),
        labels = c("2-Year Spread", "5-Year Spread", "10-Year Spread")),
      independent_label = factor(independent,
        levels = c("BII_Weighted_L1", "BHI_Weighted_L1", "EPI_L1", "NDGAIN_L1"),
        labels = c("Biodiversity Degradation (BII)", "Biodiversity Degradation (BHI)",
                   "Environmental Performance Index", "Climate Vulnerability (ND-GAIN)"))
    )

  # Single plotting function for both k=1 and k=2
  y_limits <- c(-0.3, 1.2)

  plot_qife <- function(data, k) {
    if (nrow(data) == 0) { warning(paste("No data for k=", k)); return(invisible(NULL)) }

    sigma_labels <- data %>%
      dplyr::group_by(dependent_label, independent_label) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        label = paste0("\u03c3 = ", sprintf("%.3f", mean(sigma.e, na.rm = TRUE))),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(x = 0.9, y = -Inf)

    ggplot(data, aes(x = quantile, y = estimate)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
                      ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error), fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_point(color = "red", size = 2) +
      geom_text(aes(label = significance), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
      geom_text(data = sigma_labels, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
                hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5, color = "darkgray", fontface = "italic") +
      facet_grid(dependent_label ~ independent_label) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
      labs(
        title    = paste0("Asymmetric Impact of Nature-Related Financial Vulnerability"),
        subtitle = paste0("Quantile IFE with ", k, " factor", if (k > 1) "s" else "",
                          ". Rightmost points represent high borrowing cost countries."),
        x = "Quantile", y = "Marginal Effect on Sovereign Bond Yield Spread (pp)",
        caption  = "Significance: *** p<0.01, ** p<0.05, * p<0.1. 95% confidence intervals from block-bootstrapped standard errors with 500 replications per quantile. \u03c3 = mean standard deviation of error terms. 57 countries, quarterly, 2000-2020."
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgray", color = NA),
        panel.spacing    = unit(1, "lines"),
        plot.title       = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.caption     = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey50"),
        axis.title       = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text        = element_text(size = 9)
      )
  }

  # Support legacy coef tables that used column `r` instead of `k`
  if (!"k" %in% names(qife_coefs_df) && "r" %in% names(qife_coefs_df)) {
    qife_coefs_df$k <- qife_coefs_df$r
  }
  print(plot_qife(dplyr::filter(qife_coefs_df, k == 2), k = 2))
  print(plot_qife(dplyr::filter(qife_coefs_df, k == 1), k = 1))
}
```
